title: Grilled German Sausage with Smoky Beans
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring smoky sausages and beans, inspired by traditional German cuisine.

ingredients.name: german sausages
ingredients.notes: look for sausages with a smoky flavor

ingredients.name: white beans
ingredients.notes: such as cannellini or navy beans

ingredients.name: grill seasoning
ingredients.notes: such as paprika or chili powder

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Season the sausages with grill seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Grill the sausages for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the sausages are cooking, heat the white beans in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onions are translucent.
If using BBQ sauce, add it to the pan and stir to combine.
Serve the grilled sausages with the smoky beans and enjoy!
Optional: serve with additional BBQ sauce and grilled onions on top.
